_comment: Where verify.yml runs its Windows sections (tools/ci/runner-router.cjs). Owner decision 2026-10-01: Blacksmith is out of the pool (turned off). Preference order: idle qualified self-hosted Windows hosts (edge-runn-envy / ai-devops-windows-qualified) first as extra capacity, then GitHub-hosted Windows runners; WarpBuild Azure BYOC is the final option only after GitHub-hosted and edge-runn-envy are full. A section goes to a qualified host only when one is online and idle at routing time; remaining sections go to GitHub-hosted unless that lane is full, in which case they go to WarpBuild.
